fields.title: Python Fundamentals
fields.overview: Learn the basics of Python programming, including syntax, data types, control flow, functions, and object-oriented programming. Perfect for beginners who want to start their coding journey.

fields.title: Advanced Python Techniques
fields.overview: Take your Python skills to the next level with decorators, generators, context managers, metaclasses, and asynchronous programming patterns.

fields.title: Django Web Development
fields.overview: Build robust, scalable web applications with Django. Covers models, views, templates, forms, authentication, and deployment best practices.

fields.title: Modern JavaScript & React
fields.overview: Master modern JavaScript (ES6+) and build interactive user interfaces with React. Includes hooks, state management, and component architecture.

fields.title: Data Analysis with Pandas
fields.overview: Learn to manipulate, analyze, and visualize data using the Pandas library. Covers DataFrames, Series, merging, grouping, and time series analysis.

fields.title: Introduction to Machine Learning
fields.overview: Understand the core concepts of machine learning, including supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, and popular algorithms.

fields.title: SQL & Relational Databases
fields.overview: Master SQL from basic queries to advanced joins, subqueries, indexing, and database normalization. Includes MySQL and PostgreSQL examples.

fields.title: Flutter Mobile App Development
fields.overview: Build cross-platform mobile applications with Flutter and Dart. Covers widgets, state management, navigation, and API integration.

fields.title: Docker & Kubernetes Essentials
fields.overview: Learn containerization with Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes. Covers images, containers, pods, services, and CI/CD pipelines.

fields.title: Ethical Hacking & Penetration Testing
fields.overview: Explore cybersecurity fundamentals, vulnerability assessment, and ethical hacking techniques used to secure modern systems.

fields.title: Getting Started with Python
fields.description: Install Python, set up your IDE, and write your first program.

fields.title: Variables and Data Types
fields.description: Understand integers, floats, strings, booleans, and type conversion.

fields.title: Control Flow
fields.description: Learn if/else statements, loops, and logical operators.

fields.title: Functions and Modules
fields.description: Define functions, use parameters, and organize code into modules.

fields.title: Object-Oriented Programming
fields.description: Classes, objects, inheritance, and encapsulation in Python.

fields.title: Decorators and Closures
fields.description: Write reusable code with decorators and understand closures.

fields.title: Generators and Iterators
fields.description: Master lazy evaluation with generators and custom iterators.

fields.title: Context Managers
fields.description: Use the with statement and build your own context managers.

fields.title: Metaclasses and Descriptors
fields.description: Dive deep into Python internals and advanced class customization.

fields.title: Async Programming
fields.description: Learn asyncio, coroutines, and concurrent programming patterns.

fields.title: Django Setup and Project Structure
fields.description: Install Django, create a project, and understand the MVT architecture.

fields.title: Models and Databases
fields.description: Define models, run migrations, and interact with the ORM.

fields.title: Views and URLs
fields.description: Create function-based and class-based views with URL routing.

fields.title: Templates and Static Files
fields.description: Build dynamic HTML pages with Django templates.

fields.title: Authentication and Authorization
fields.description: Implement user login, registration, and permissions.

fields.title: ES6+ Features

fields.title: React Hooks
